atoms.text: Mr Waddle wants to explore the seven continents. Shall we start with Europe?

instruction.text: Can you point out Europe to Mr Waddle on the map?
Mr Waddle explores some European cities. Select the images of cities he might visit.

feedback.wrong: The Grand Canyon is a natural landscape in North America.

instruction.text: Mr Waddle heard there is a European mountain range called the Alps. Find the highest point of the mountain to tell him a fun fact.

feedback.end: The Alps are spread over 8 countries, including France, Germany and Italy.

instruction.text: Mr Waddle explores some other European landscapes. Select the images of natural European landscapes.

hint.text: Most countries in Europe have a temperate climate, which means they don’t get extremely hot or cold.

feedback.end: Keep in mind that there are still differences across a continent! For example, Southern Europe is warmer and drier than Northern Europe.
feedback.wrong: These are the Pyramids of Giza in Africa. They were built by the ancient Egyptians around 4,500 years ago.

instruction.text: Spell the word to tell Mr Waddle the name of the largest and most populated country in Europe.

atoms.word: R u s s i a

feedback.end: Russia is the largest country in the world. It is so big that it is actually part of both Europe and Asia!
